environment.description: AWS Lambda function (Node.js 18.x) deployed with a Lambda Function URL. The function URL is configured with AuthType=AWS_IAM. The resource-based policy on the function specifies Condition: {"StringEquals": {"lambda:FunctionUrlAuthType": "AWS_IAM"}} and the Principal is restricted to arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:role/DocConverterClientRole. No public invoke permission exists. Note: the function itself has no input validation middleware — the auth boundary is solely at the Function URL invocation layer. IAM policy on DocConverterClientRole includes lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl but callers must SigV4-sign requests. Unsigned HTTP requests to the function URL endpoint receive HTTP 403 {"Message":"Forbidden"} before the Lambda runtime is invoked.
